g.text: Timing advantages survive any pattern of missing interviews but not small amounts of worst-case answer error
Hatched bars: exact identification ranges (not confidence intervals) over every completion of missing screens, plus a shared budget of flipped recorded answers chosen adversarially; dot =
complete-case value. Solver validated by brute force.
